features.quote: Give the model an exit. Provide an explicit `give_up(reason)` / `report_blocked(reason)` tool.
features.justification_quote: Without it you can't distinguish "spiraled" from "had no legal move except to keep trying."

features.quote: if repetition score and self-criticism density both cross threshold for N consecutive turns... you can truncate the run
features.justification_quote: further turns add little signal... save tokens

features.quote: Turn cap: the death spiral needs runway. Set max turns generously (e.g. 40)
features.justification_quote: log everything so you can measure *when* degradation onsets

features.quote: include a variant *with* a mid-task nudge and measure recovery rate
features.justification_quote: recovery-after-nudge is itself a useful reliability metric
